nav.title: AI Contact Center
nav.subtitle: Multilingual self-service with governed human handoff.

customer.title: Start a conversation
customer.consentText: I agree this conversation may be processed by the configured AI provider. Transcripts are encrypted before storage.
customer.setupHint: Unavailable until an administrator configures the encryption key and AI provider.
customer.startHint: Create a consented session to begin.
customer.chatEmpty: Messages appear here. AI actions are suggestions only; no payments, account changes, refunds, or dispatches are executed.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Browser voice is streamed to the configured provider; OpsCore does not claim to store raw audio.
customer.voiceRequirement: Browser voice requires HTTPS (or localhost), a microphone, consent, a configured Realtime model and provider key. It is not a PSTN/SIP phone bridge.

queue.title: Escalation queue
queue.description: High-risk, unresolved, or human-requested conversations appear here. A queue item means requested, not connected.
queue.empty: No active human handoffs for this organization.
queue.replyStorageNote: Human replies are encrypted at rest and are visible in the conversation transcript.

boundaries.title: Operational boundaries
boundaries.automateBody: Multilingual first response, clarification, intent and risk triage, secure transcript storage, queue creation and agent assignment.
boundaries.humanBody: Explicit human request, low confidence, high or critical risk, missing policy, unresolved case, privacy or security complaint, or uncertain action.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Not enabled by this package alone
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/email routing, live telephony bridge, CRM identity verification and language-quality claims need a real provider adapter, credentials and acceptance tests.

messages.qualificationNotice: No language is production-qualified until text, ASR, TTS, accent and escalation tests pass.
messages.configOk: Configuration exists. Provider connectivity and language quality still need live acceptance tests.
messages.conversationCreated: Secure conversation created. Language quality is not yet production-qualified.
messages.handoffQueued: Human handoff queued ({reason}). This is a queue request, not a live connection.
messages.aiResponseFailed: The AI response was not completed. No action was executed. You can request a human representative.
messages.apiUnavailable: The Contact Center API could not be loaded. Sign in to the OpsCore console, then reload this page.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Human handoff queued ({reason}). The queue does not prove an agent is connected.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Human handoff queued. The browser AI session is stopping; live telephony transfer is not configured.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Realtime provider reported an error. Stop the voice session and retry after checking provider configuration.
messages.voiceActive: Voice session is active. Press “Request human” at any time; this creates a queue item, not a PSTN transfer.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Consent is required before a conversation can start.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: The server response could not be read.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: The realtime voice provider could not be reached.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support realtime voice.
errors.HANDOFF_NOT_CLAIMED: The handoff could not be claimed.
